; Output of `z80dasm hello.com -l 0x34`, where hello.com is
; asm/examples/hello.asm assembled by z80asm. Matches hello.asm's real
; instruction stream exactly, including auto-generated labels (L010D for
; the DJNZ loop target, L0129 for the JP NZ target).
;
; Limited to the 0x34-byte code region (up to but not including the
; embedded message strings at 0x134) deliberately: this disassembler does
; straightforward linear decoding with no code/data separation, so
; feeding it the message text too would (correctly, expectedly) produce
; garbage - ASCII bytes decoded as if they were opcodes. See
; docs/ROADMAP.md's disassembler section for that trade-off.

        org 0100h

        LD DE,0134h             ; 0100: 11 34 01 
        LD C,09h                ; 0103: 0E 09 
        CALL 0005h              ; 0105: CD 05 00 
        LD B,05h                ; 0108: 06 05 
        LD HL,0000h             ; 010A: 21 00 00 
L010D:
        INC HL                  ; 010D: 23 
        DJNZ L010D              ; 010E: 10 FD 
        LD A,L                  ; 0110: 7D 
        CP 05h                  ; 0111: FE 05 
        JP NZ,L0129             ; 0113: C2 29 01 
        ADD A,30h               ; 0116: C6 30 
        LD E,A                  ; 0118: 5F 
        LD C,02h                ; 0119: 0E 02 
        CALL 0005h              ; 011B: CD 05 00 
        LD DE,0147h             ; 011E: 11 47 01 
        LD C,09h                ; 0121: 0E 09 
        CALL 0005h              ; 0123: CD 05 00 
        JP 0000h                ; 0126: C3 00 00 
L0129:
        LD DE,014Ah             ; 0129: 11 4A 01 
        LD C,09h                ; 012C: 0E 09 
        CALL 0005h              ; 012E: CD 05 00 
        JP 0000h                ; 0131: C3 00 00
